title: Core expanded fixed-coordinate scalar calculation
statement: After applying naturality of the fixed pullback coordinate comparison, the remaining tensor-coordinate, upper-star comparison, and final fixed pullback factors satisfy the displayed scalar naturality equation.

source.place: Naturality coordinate calculation after fixed-coordinate expansion.

proof.text: For the coordinate functor F, second-input inverse realization Q, and fixed tensor W, prove joint naturality of tensorCoordinates from Equivalence.unitInv_naturality applied to W.map(F.map f,Q.map g). Bundle these components into q:T⋙F≅(F×Q)⋙W. The partial tensor definition identifies its morphism with realization of that fixed tensor morphism.

Let P be the fixed identity pullback, U its finite constructible version, and V its finite-Tor restriction. The existing pullCoordinatesIso gives a:U⋙F≅F⋙P and, after restriction, c:V⋙Q≅Q⋙P. Compose q followed by the published bifunctorial derived pullback tensor comparison and tensor of a inverse to obtain a natural transformation eta. Compose the restriction of q with tensor of c to obtain the target coordinate natural transformation tau.

The fixed-coordinate expansion identifies F.map(pullbackTensorComparison).hom followed by tau with fixedPullRealization at the source tensor followed by eta. Naturality of eta moves the input morphism to its target functor; substitute that expansion and use naturality of tau in the opposite direction. Expanding the components and associating compositions gives exactly the required scalar equation.

proof_origin.place: Joint naturality of the explicit tensor coordinate and pullback comparisons, assembled as natural transformations on the product category; Stacks Tag 07A4 supplies the published bifunctorial comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePartialTensor_identityNaturality_coordinates_expanded_core
    (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E n hn) (X : SixFunctorSpace D) :
    letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n hn
    let U := S.finite.pull (𝟙 X)
    let V := CompactSupportFiniteProjection.torPull S (𝟙 X)
    let T := Functor.uncurry.obj (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.partialTensor S X)
    ∀ (M M' : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X)
      (L L' : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn X.obj.left)
      (f : M ⟶ M') (g : L ⟶ L'),
      (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.fixedPullRealization S (𝟙 X)
          (T.obj (M, L))).hom ≫
        (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.fixedDerivedPull
          (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (𝟙 X)).map
          ((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n)
            (hn := hn) X).map (T.map (Prod.mkHom f g))) ≫
        (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.fixedDerivedPull
          (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (𝟙 X)).map
          (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.tensorCoordinates S X M' L').hom ≫
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1}
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n))) ((𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).hom.left)).app
          ((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n)
            (hn := hn) X).obj M')).app
          ((realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) X).inverse.obj L'.obj) ≫
        ((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.fixedTensor (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) X).map
          (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.fixedPullRealization S (𝟙 X) M').inv).app
          ((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.fixedDerivedPull
            (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (𝟙 X)).obj
            ((realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) X).inverse.obj L'.obj)) =
      (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n)
          (hn := hn) X).map
          (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.pullbackTensorComparison S (𝟙 X) M L).hom ≫
        (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n)
          (hn := hn) X).map (T.map (Prod.mkHom (U.map f) (V.map g))) ≫
        (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.targetCoordinates S (𝟙 X) (U.obj M') L').hom
